description: This is a CMake script defining functions for configuring and installing header-only libraries and packages, including generating configuration files and package config files.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Configures and installs a header-only library's CMake configuration files, setting dependencies, targets, and templates.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Configures and installs a package configuration file, generating a pkg-config file with appropriate include paths, compile options, and libraries.
